intro: A spa, a vitamin store, a sanctuary shop and a naturopathic practice all offer scan sessions in Alabama, and the AO Scan is the device that links most of them. This page covers bioresonance practitioners in Foley, Birmingham and Vestavia Hills, Decatur and Killen. Five practices share it, with 164 reviews between them at an average of 4.9.

Foley has two. Be Balanced Spa is a women owned spa offering an AO Scan along with massage, Reiki, sound baths, Bemer sessions and ionic foot baths, and a doctor of acupuncture and a holistic life coach are part of the team. It is rated 4.8 from 65 reviews. Quantum Energy Healing LLC, run by Chelsea Burns, offers scan sessions with the AO Scan and the Equiscope for animals. Chelsea describes the AO Scan as an educational wellness tool that gives frequency-based feedback, used for people, dogs and horses alike, and the practice is rated 5.0 from 2 reviews.

Doc Bodie Cares is a naturopathic wellness practice led by Dr. Stefanie Bodie, ND, serving Vestavia Hills and Birmingham and working virtually across the United States and internationally. Services include Emotion Code, personalised wellness programs, supplement recommendations and AO Scan sessions with Inner Voice scans. It is rated 5.0 from 40 reviews.

In Killen, Shoals Healing Frequencies is a metaphysical and holistic shop and sanctuary built around sound, light and frequency. April offers biofeedback scans and AO Scan sessions alongside massage, Reiki and intuitive readings, for people and for pets. Sessions run 60 minutes in person or remotely over Zoom, with booking through Vagaro. It is rated 5.0 from 21 reviews.

The ZYTO scanner turns up in an unexpected place. Gloria's Good Health in Decatur has been a locally owned vitamin, supplement and health food store since 1989, and alongside supplements and natural foods it offers vibration platform sessions, an infrared sauna and a ZYTO scanner. It has curbside pickup and delivery, and is rated 4.6 from 36 reviews. Anyone planning a ZYTO session there can ask in store how long a scan takes, what the follow up looks like and whether booking ahead is needed.

Remote sessions and sessions for animals both appear at two practices, so the choices extend beyond a visit to a studio. Neighbouring pages cover Georgia, Tennessee, Louisiana, South Carolina and Kentucky.

faqs.q: Where can I find an AO Scan session in Alabama?
faqs.a: AO Scan sessions are offered by Be Balanced Spa and Quantum Energy Healing LLC in Foley, by Doc Bodie Cares in Vestavia Hills and Birmingham, and by Shoals Healing Frequencies in Killen. Be Balanced Spa is rated 4.8 from 65 reviews and Doc Bodie Cares 5.0 from 40.

faqs.q: Which Alabama practitioners work remotely?
faqs.a: Doc Bodie Cares works virtually across the United States and internationally, and Shoals Healing Frequencies offers 60 minute sessions over Zoom as well as in person. Doc Bodie Cares is led by Dr. Stefanie Bodie, ND.

faqs.q: Can pets have sessions in Alabama?
faqs.a: Shoals Healing Frequencies in Killen offers biofeedback scans and AO Scan sessions for pets as well as people, and Quantum Energy Healing LLC in Foley uses the Equiscope for animals, for dogs and horses alongside people. Ratings are 5.0 from 21 reviews and 5.0 from 2.

faqs.q: Who offers a ZYTO scanner in Alabama?
faqs.a: Gloria's Good Health in Decatur, a vitamin and health food store open since 1989, has a ZYTO scanner and is rated 4.6 from 36 reviews. Call ahead to ask how a session is booked.

faqs.q: Which pages sit next to Alabama?
faqs.a: Georgia, Tennessee, Louisiana, South Carolina and Kentucky each have their own page. They help anyone near the state line who is happy to travel.

intro: Alberta's bioresonance practitioners work from Calgary, Edmonton, Sherwood Park, Beaumont, Red Deer and Bow Island. This page holds eight practices, and the combined reviews come to 79 with an average of 5.0. Calgary has the longest review histories, while elsewhere in the province practices have a single review or none yet.

Calgary carries the most reviewed names. Integrative Health Centre in southwest Calgary is led by Dr Chantelle Drobot, ND, and combines naturopathic care with chiropractic, Chinese medicine, acupuncture and massage. A ZYTO scan is among its services alongside personalised supplement plans, and new appointments can be booked online. It is rated 4.9 from 63 reviews. Cheryle Cote Holistic Healing has worked in Calgary for 40 years across hypnotherapy, Reiki, tuning forks and BodyTalk, and offers quantum bioresonance biofeedback and bioresonance sound sessions. It is rated 4.9 from 12 reviews.

The Edmonton area follows. The Optimal Health & Wellness Program in Edmonton offers NES Health bio-energetic scanning with life and wellness coaching, rated 5.0 from 1 review. Blue Iris Healthcare Inc. in Sherwood Park is run by a herbalist who is also a bioresonance therapist, offering energy work, nutritional counselling and health coaching, rated 5.0 from 1 review. Wellness Concepts Ltd - Rife Frequency Healing in Beaumont is a women-owned practice working with Rife and resonant frequencies, serving the Edmonton area and central Alberta.

Mokelky Health & MediSpa in Red Deer is a family-run wellness center offering bioresonance sessions with BEMER PEMF mat sessions, red light and health coaching. Mat sessions run 10 to 40 minutes and are described as suitable for people or pets, and remote services are arranged by email. Buffaloberry Bioresonance in Bow Island works with a Rayonex device. Its electroids carry signals to the machine, a method that goes back to the work of Paul Schmitt.

The devices named on this page are ZYTO, NES Health and Rayonex, one practice each. Red Deer is where remote sessions and sessions for pets are named. The practices differ in type: a naturopathic clinic, a hypnotherapy and energy practice, a herbalist, a frequency practice and a wellness spa.

Because most of the single-review ratings are 5.0, a rating alone says little, and the review count is the better guide to how much history a practice has. Phoning ahead to ask which device is used and how a first session works is the simplest way to compare the smaller practices. Alberta's neighbouring pages are Saskatchewan, British Columbia, Manitoba, Ontario and Quebec.

faqs.q: Where in Alberta can I find a ZYTO scan?
faqs.a: Integrative Health Centre in southwest Calgary offers a ZYTO scan with personalised supplement plans, within a clinic that also covers naturopathic care, chiropractic, acupuncture and massage. It is led by Dr Chantelle Drobot, ND, and rated 4.9 from 63 reviews. Online booking is open.

faqs.q: Which Alberta practitioners use NES Health or Rayonex?
faqs.a: The Optimal Health & Wellness Program in Edmonton offers NES Health bio-energetic scanning, and Buffaloberry Bioresonance in Bow Island uses a Rayonex device. The first is rated 5.0 from 1 review, and the second has yet to collect reviews.

faqs.q: Does anyone in Alberta offer sessions for pets?
faqs.a: Mokelky Health & MediSpa in Red Deer describes its PEMF mat sessions as suitable for people or pets, and offers remote services arranged by email. It is a family-run wellness center rated 5.0 from 1 review.

faqs.q: Who works in the Edmonton area and central Alberta?
faqs.a: Wellness Concepts Ltd - Rife Frequency Healing in Beaumont serves the Edmonton area and central Alberta, using Rife and resonant frequencies. The Optimal Health & Wellness Program is in Edmonton itself, and Blue Iris Healthcare Inc. is in Sherwood Park.

faqs.q: Which pages sit next to Alberta?
faqs.a: Saskatchewan, British Columbia, Manitoba, Ontario and Quebec each have a page. They are worth a look for anyone near the provincial border who is willing to travel for a session.

intro: The Arad page covers 4 bioresonance practitioners. Arad sits in western Romania, near the Hungarian border, and the oldest name here predates most of the trade: BIOMEDICA was founded in 1993 by Mircea Iorga, who has offered biotherapy and magnetic bioresonance since that year.

BIOMEDICA is rated 4.7 from 12 reviews. The bioenergetic sessions are given by the practitioner personally and need intense focus, so they run only in the morning. The practice publishes in Romanian and English, with testimonials, a FAQ and a blog.

Euthymia Therapy is a family counseling practice that also offers aromatherapy, ZYTO scans and massage. It is rated 5.0 from 1 review, a very short history. A third listing, Consultant doTERRA & Scanare ZYTO, pairs doTERRA essential oil consulting with ZYTO scanning, and Metatron biorezonanta is an Arad listing for bioresonance sessions. Call ahead to confirm what a session includes and where it takes place.

Arad has one long-running practice with a track record, BIOMEDICA, and three smaller names with short review histories. BIOMEDICA publishes in two languages, which matters for readers coming across the border. Euthymia Therapy fits families who want counseling, aromatherapy and a ZYTO scan from one place. For the smaller names, a phone call is the way to confirm what is offered.
Across the page there are 13 Google reviews with an average rating of 4.8. Readers who can travel to Timișoara or Oradea can also look at the pages for Timiș, Bihor, Hunedoara, Cluj and Sibiu.

faqs.q: Who has offered bioresonance in Arad the longest?
faqs.a: BIOMEDICA, founded in 1993 by Mircea Iorga, who offers biotherapy and magnetic bioresonance. It is rated 4.7 from 12 reviews and publishes in Romanian and English.

faqs.q: Are sessions at BIOMEDICA available in the afternoon?
faqs.a: The practice says bioenergetic sessions need intense focus and run only in the morning. Contact the practice to arrange a time.

faqs.q: Who offers ZYTO scans in Arad?
faqs.a: Euthymia Therapy, a family counseling practice that also offers aromatherapy and massage, is rated 5.0 from 1 review. Consultant doTERRA & Scanare ZYTO pairs ZYTO scanning with essential oil consulting.

faqs.q: Which nearby areas have their own page?
faqs.a: Timiș, Bihor, Hunedoara, Cluj and Sibiu each have a page. Timișoara and Oradea are both within reach of Arad.

intro: The Argeș page covers 4 bioresonance practitioners. Three are in Pitești and one is in Gorganu, and the Pitești ones lean toward pairing bioresonance with nutrition coaching and lifestyle work.

BIOREZONANTA PITESTI, at Aleea Spitalului 18, is the best reviewed, rated 5.0 from 38 reviews. It offers bioresonance and biofeedback sessions with a stated 18 years of experience, names SCIO and NLS equipment, and says it works with eight devices. Bookings run by phone or WhatsApp every day from 9 to 22, and online booking is available.

Biorezonanta si nutritie, founded in 2007, pairs bioresonance with nutrition coaching under the banner of energy and a healthier lifestyle. It offers a wellness evaluation, a follow-up re-evaluation and sessions of dedicated bioresonance work, described as non-invasive, plus 7-day and 21-day nutrition programmes. It is rated 5.0 from 4 reviews.

Herbalife Wellness Center Consulting, at Wellness Club Concept in Pitești, covers personalised nutrition consultation, bioresonance, functional training, yoga, Pilates Reformer and relaxation massage. It is rated 4.7 from 17 reviews. In Gorganu, Centrul Naturist Filip is the practice of Claudia Filip, offering nutrition consultation and bioresonance sessions, rated 5.0 from 15 reviews. Appointments are requested by email.

Pitești is the centre of the trade in Argeș. Three of the four practices are there, and two of them, BIOREZONANTA PITESTI and Biorezonanta si nutritie, are built around bioresonance itself. The other two offer it as one service among nutrition, training and consultation. Bookings are by phone, WhatsApp, private message or email depending on the practice.
Across the page there are 74 Google reviews with an average rating of 4.9. Readers who can travel can also look at the pages for Prahova, Brașov, Bucharest, Sibiu and Mureș.

faqs.q: Who offers NLS or SCIO sessions in Pitești?
faqs.a: BIOREZONANTA PITESTI names a Life Resonance Intelligence System along with SCIO and NLS equipment. It is rated 5.0 from 38 reviews and takes bookings by phone, WhatsApp or online.

faqs.q: Where in Argeș can I combine bioresonance with nutrition coaching?
faqs.a: Biorezonanta si nutritie in Pitești offers nutrition assessment and 7-day and 21-day programmes. Herbalife Wellness Center Consulting offers personalised nutrition consultation, and Centrul Naturist Filip in Gorganu offers nutrition consultation.

faqs.q: Is there a practice outside Pitești?
faqs.a: Centrul Naturist Filip in Gorganu, the practice of Claudia Filip, offers nutrition consultation and bioresonance sessions. It is rated 5.0 from 15 reviews.

faqs.q: How do I book at BIOREZONANTA PITESTI?
faqs.a: Bookings run by phone or WhatsApp every day from 9 to 22, and online booking is available. The practice is at Aleea Spitalului 18 in Pitești, and it says it works with eight devices.

faqs.q: Which nearby areas have their own page?
faqs.a: Prahova, Brașov, Bucharest, Sibiu and Mureș each have a page. Three of the Argeș practices are in Pitești and one is in Gorganu, so readers elsewhere may find a closer practice on those pages.

intro: Arizona's bioresonance practitioners work from nine towns across the state rather than from one metro area. Nine practices are shown: Scottsdale, Mesa and Fountain Hills, then Tucson, Prescott, Flagstaff, Yuma and Buckeye.

Scottsdale has two of them. Quasar Quantum Healing, rated 5.0 from 63 reviews, is a wellness center that offers the Comprehensive AO Scan with its Digital Body Analyzer, and the same site has a Himalayan salt cave, a hyperbaric chamber and yoga classes. It works by appointment only, and a free first consultation is available. Angel of Hearts Wellness, also in Scottsdale, offers ZYTO Evox biofeedback sessions built around perception reframing and balance, and has yet to collect reviews. Fountain Hills sits just to the east, where Modern Wellness offers biofeedback, bioenergetic and bioresonance sessions as custom wellness screenings, rated 5.0 from 3 reviews.

Devices are a mix here, described in words rather than counted. ZYTO is the device named most often: Ray Chiropractic Center, PLLC in Mesa has recently added a ZYTO scan to a chiropractic practice, and Mountain Air Chiropractic in Prescott offers ZYTO scans alongside PEMF, cold laser and muscle testing. The AO Scan, with its voice-based sessions, shows up in Scottsdale, Yuma and Buckeye. Blessed Balance and Love in Yuma offers AO Scan voice sessions in Spanish, with auriculotherapy, Access Bars and Bach flowers on the same menu, and is rated 5.0 from 10 reviews. Healing Moon in Buckeye pairs AO Scan sessions with Reiki, energy work and handmade crystal jewelry, by appointment arranged through text.

Tucson and Flagstaff each have a practice of their own. In Tucson, LS Quantum Biofeedback offers Quantum Biofeedback LIFE System sessions, either in person or over Zoom, with a recording and notes sent after a distance session. It is rated 5.0 from 15 reviews. In Flagstaff, The Wellness Initiative is led by a Doctor of Natural Medicine and offers full body bioresonance scans next to auriculotherapy with ear seeds, fitness and nutrition guidance and mindfulness practices. Clients there start with a comprehensive wellness assessment.

The kinds of practice are broad. Two are chiropractic offices, one is a Spanish language holistic practice, one is a spa style wellness center, one is a reflexology and energy studio, and the rest are naturopathic or coaching led. The remote option in Tucson reaches clients wherever they live in the state.

Reviews are strong across the page, with the combined total at 120 and an average of 4.9. Two practices have yet to collect their first reviews. Neighbouring state pages cover Nevada, New Mexico, Utah, California and Colorado, which suits anyone near the state line, for example around Yuma, who might be comparing practitioners across the border.

faqs.q: Which Arizona practitioners offer ZYTO scan sessions?
faqs.a: ZYTO sessions are offered by Ray Chiropractic Center, PLLC in Mesa, Mountain Air Chiropractic in Prescott and Angel of Hearts Wellness in Scottsdale. Angel of Hearts focuses on ZYTO Evox biofeedback sessions, while the two chiropractic offices add ZYTO to wider practices that include nutrition, cold laser and PEMF.

faqs.q: Is there anyone in Arizona who offers sessions at a distance?
faqs.a: LS Quantum Biofeedback in Tucson offers Quantum Biofeedback LIFE System sessions over Zoom as well as in person. A distance session comes with a recording, personalised notes and educational materials, and the client only needs a quiet place to relax. It is rated 5.0 from 15 reviews.

faqs.q: Where in Arizona can I find an AO Scan session?
faqs.a: AO Scan sessions are offered in Scottsdale at Quasar Quantum Healing, in Yuma at Blessed Balance and Love, which runs sessions in Spanish, and in Buckeye at Healing Moon. Quasar is rated 5.0 from 63 reviews and Blessed Balance and Love 5.0 from 10.

faqs.q: Which Arizona towns have a practitioner outside Scottsdale and Mesa?
faqs.a: Yes. Tucson has LS Quantum Biofeedback, Prescott has Mountain Air Chiropractic, Flagstaff has The Wellness Initiative and Yuma has Blessed Balance and Love. Each works from its own town, so the page spans the state rather than one metro area.

faqs.q: Which nearby state pages can I look at from Arizona?
faqs.a: The pages next to Arizona cover Nevada, New Mexico, Utah, California and Colorado. They are useful for anyone living near a state line who is willing to travel, or who wants to compare the kinds of practices and devices offered across the border.

intro: Auckland is a place where bioresonance practitioners are as likely to meet clients on a screen as in a room. Of the nine practices on this page, five offer remote sessions, and the rest are spread across the city, Grey Lynn, Orewa to the north, Pukekohe and Bombay to the south, and the Whangaparaoa coast. This page covers bioresonance practitioners in and around Auckland, with a neighbouring page for Canterbury.

The devices named here are varied. BioEnergetix, run by Chantelle French and rated 5.0 from 11 reviews, uses the NES Health Energy4Life scan together with the Genius Insight Voice Scan, and offers both in person and remote sessions. SoulfulSync Holistic Studio in Orewa, also rated 5.0 from 11 reviews, is run by Eva, who holds a Diploma in Quantum Biofeedback, and uses the Scio device. A 45 minute Reset is offered in person in Auckland or remotely, and a longer 90 minute Deep Reset goes further.

Naturopathy and homeopathy are a recurring thread. Inbalance Naturopathy & Body Therapy in Grey Lynn combines naturopathic consultation with bioresonance, iridology and Reiki, and an AO Scan Inner Voice scan creates personalised audio files. It also arranges remote sessions for clients elsewhere, and for dogs, cats and horses, from basic information about the animal. It is rated 5.0 from 5 reviews. Native Herbs LTD is an Auckland homeopath practice with a shop for herbal and homeopathic products made in New Zealand, and its services menu includes bio-resonance analysis.

South of the city, Kat's Natural Solutions is a naturopathy practice based in Pukekohe and Bombay that also supports clients online. It combines nutrition and lifestyle guidance with a Functional Health Screening that uses bioresonance as a non-invasive scan. A free 15 minute discovery call is open to new clients. It is rated 5.0 from 2 reviews.

Two entries sit under the name Bioresonance Therapy Clinic, each rated 5.0 from 1 review. One is run by Caroll Macy in Auckland and walks new clients through a set sequence from initial assessment to a series of sessions. The other offers FCT bioresonance sessions and online consultations, and is entered under Whangaparaoa while stating a move to Bethlehem, Tauranga, so anyone interested should confirm the address and service area by phone before planning a visit.

Together the page holds a total of 37 reviews with an average of 4.9. Ratings are high, but several practices have only a handful of reviews behind them, so the count matters as much as the number. Remote sessions are easy to find across the page, which suits clients outside the city or those who prefer a session from home.

faqs.q: Who offers remote bioresonance sessions around Auckland?
faqs.a: BioEnergetix, SoulfulSync Holistic Studio, Inbalance Naturopathy & Body Therapy, Kat's Natural Solutions and a Bioresonance Therapy Clinic entry all offer remote or online sessions. BioEnergetix works with both in person and remote clients, and Inbalance also arranges remote sessions for pets.

faqs.q: Which Auckland practitioners work with animals?
faqs.a: Inbalance Naturopathy & Body Therapy in Grey Lynn arranges remote bioresonance sessions for dogs, cats and horses, using basic information about the animal. It is the practice on the Auckland page that names animal sessions, and it is rated 5.0 from 5 reviews.

faqs.q: Is there a practitioner north of the city centre?
faqs.a: SoulfulSync Holistic Studio is in Orewa, north of Auckland. Run by Eva, it offers Scio quantum frequency biofeedback sessions, with Bioptron light and singing bowl sessions alongside. It holds a 5.0 rating from 11 reviews, and sessions are also available in Auckland or remotely.

faqs.q: Does anyone in Auckland offer a free first conversation?
faqs.a: Kat's Natural Solutions in Pukekohe and Bombay offers a free 15 minute discovery call to new clients before any session is booked. The practice combines holistic nutrition and lifestyle guidance with a bioresonance scan, and it supports clients online as well.

faqs.q: Which nearby page covers practitioners outside Auckland?
faqs.a: Canterbury is the neighbouring page and has its own practitioners. Several of the Auckland practices also work remotely, so distance from the city does not have to limit the choice for clients elsewhere in the country.

intro: Baden-Württemberg has 116 bioresonance practitioners, and the trade here is made up of small Naturheilpraxis practices in towns from Karlsruhe and Mannheim to Konstanz, Überlingen and Aalen. For someone searching for bioresonance practitioners in Baden-Württemberg, the choice is usually a practice in a regional town, often with a second location or a stated service area nearby. The neighbouring region pages are Saarland, Bavaria, Rhineland-Palatinate, Hesse and Thuringia.

In Karlsruhe Durlach, Naturheilpraxis Karlsruhe - Elke Gerhardt - Heilpraktikerin has been in practice since 1986 and focuses on bioresonance with a BICOM optima device, drawing up an individual plan for each client. It is rated 4.9 from 109 reviews. Nearby, Naturheilpraxis Birgit Mark in Durmersheim offers bioresonance sessions with micronutrient guidance and stress support, rated 5.0 from 26 reviews, and Claudia Beilicke, Heilpraktiker, in Graben-Neudorf combines bioresonance with gut health and nutrient support, rated 5.0 from 25 reviews.

Around Stuttgart, the practices spread across several towns. Carolin Falter Heilpraktikerin in Nürtingen works with health kinesiology, Traditional Chinese Medicine and Brain-Gym next to bioresonance, rated 5.0 from 74 reviews. Alexander Tripathi in Zell unter Aichelberg and Dürnau serves Göppingen, Kirchheim unter Teck and Weilheim an der Teck, with osteopathy as the main offer, rated 5.0 from 69 reviews. Naturheilpraxis Heilpraktiker Kreuer in Wernau bei Stuttgart und Esslingen combines classic naturopathy with bioresonance after Paul Schmidt and has been full time since 1992, rated 4.7 from 37 reviews. Praxis Beate Braun in Ludwigsburg adds birth preparation courses, doula support and postnatal care, rated 5.0 from 49 reviews.

In Mannheim and Weinheim, Naturheilpraxis Renate Nienaber in Weinheim pairs naturopathy with natural aesthetics and Regumed bioresonance, rated 5.0 from 38 reviews, and Heilpraktiker Dr. Michael Hoster at Naturheilpraxis kerngesund² in Mannheim combines a Vitalstoff scan, bioresonance, magnetic field sessions and nutrient support, rated 4.8 from 36 reviews. Dr. med. Brigitte Krug in Weinheim is a physician and ear, nose and throat specialist who includes bioresonance in her naturopathic methods, rated 3.8 from 174 reviews.

Toward the south and east, TIME4HEALTH - Hypnose und Bioresonanz Praxis Maritta Schmid in Schwäbisch Gmünd also serves the Lake Constance region, with bioresonance described as a gentle, non-invasive session aimed at stress reduction and energetic balance, rated 4.9 from 47 reviews. Heilpraktikerin Nadja Engel in Laupheim combines naturopathy and aesthetics, rated 5.0 from 39 reviews. Bodycare-Hall in Schwäbisch Hall focuses on gut health, women's wellbeing and bioresonance, rated 5.0 from 34 reviews. In Aidlingen, Naturheilpraxis Kempter works with Rayonex devices and combines sessions with Pneumatron cupping massage and fasting, rated 5.0 from 36 reviews. In Überlingen, a physician's practice led by Dr. Gregor Dietze offers BICOM sessions, rated 5.0 from 32 reviews. Osteopathie & Naturheilpraxis Sabine Kraus in Unterkochen, Aalen, is rated 5.0 from 26 reviews, and Naturheilpraxis Poeffel in Buchen im Odenwald uses a Rayonex device, rated 5.0 from 28 reviews.

Distance sessions are offered by several practitioners, including BrandauVital - Integrative Gesundheit & Naturheilkunde Praxisinstitut & Akademie with TimeWaver and a free first consultation, and NECK Lebensart / ThinkingPink, the only practice on the page that lists a ZYTO scan.

faqs.q: Who offers BICOM bioresonance in Baden-Württemberg?
faqs.a: Naturheilpraxis Karlsruhe - Elke Gerhardt - Heilpraktikerin in Karlsruhe Durlach works with a BICOM optima device and has been in practice since 1986. Praxis Symphonie - Katharina Hopfner, Heilpraktikerin and Naturheilpraxis Gabriele Woschek Heilpraktikerin also list BICOM, and both offer remote sessions.

faqs.q: Which practices work with Rayonex devices in Baden-Württemberg?
faqs.a: Naturheilpraxis Kempter in Aidlingen focuses on bioresonance with Rayonex devices. Naturheilpraxis Poeffel in Buchen im Odenwald uses a Rayonex device, and Naturheilpraxis Heilpraktiker Kreuer in Wernau works after Paul Schmidt with frequency harmonisation sessions.

faqs.q: Who serves Göppingen and Kirchheim unter Teck?
faqs.a: Alexander Tripathi, Osteopathie, Akupunktur, Neuraltherapie, Heilpraktiker, has practices in Zell unter Aichelberg and Dürnau and serves Göppingen, Kirchheim unter Teck and Weilheim an der Teck. Osteopathy is the main offer, including sessions for babies and children, with bioresonance as an additional method.

faqs.q: Can I book a ZYTO scan or a remote session in Baden-Württemberg?
faqs.a: NECK Lebensart / ThinkingPink lists a ZYTO scan together with remote sessions and a free first consultation. BrandauVital - Integrative Gesundheit & Naturheilkunde Praxisinstitut & Akademie offers TimeWaver sessions at a distance with a free first consultation.

faqs.q: Who works around Lake Constance?
faqs.a: TIME4HEALTH - Hypnose und Bioresonanz Praxis Maritta Schmid in Schwäbisch Gmünd also serves the Lake Constance region. Naturheilkundezentrum Langenargen GmbH and Naturmedizin bodensee are also on the page, and a physician's practice in Überlingen offers BICOM sessions.

faqs.q: Which region pages are next to Baden-Württemberg?
faqs.a: The neighbouring region pages are Bavaria with 175 practitioners, Hesse with 58, Rhineland-Palatinate with 31, Thuringia with 18 and Saarland with 10. Someone near the edge of Baden-Württemberg may find a closer practice on one of those pages.

intro: Bavaria has 175 bioresonance practitioners, and they are spread across large cities and very small places alike. Practices sit in München and Augsburg, but also in Rottendorf, Teisendorf, Moorenweis, Penzberg and Obermeitingen. For someone searching for bioresonance practitioners in Bavaria, that usually means a practice in or near their own town, and several practitioners also work from a distance. The neighbouring region pages are Baden-Württemberg, Thuringia, Hesse, Saxony and Rhineland-Palatinate.

München has the densest cluster of practices. Diatrofi MB is a nutrition counselling practice for toddlers, teenagers and adults that adds bioresonance measurements as an option, rated 5.0 from 42 reviews. Stefan A. Mau, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in München-Westend, runs Naturheilpraxis & Massage and combines the Power Life Scan, SCIO biofeedback, a vital-field scan and BICOM bioresonance; it is rated 5.0 from 36 reviews. Miriam Boos-Cyppel trained in Traditional Chinese Medicine in China between 2012 and 2016 and works with acupuncture, acupressure massage and Thai foot reflexology next to bioresonance, rated 5.0 from 35 reviews. In Grünwald, Dr. med. Isa Kübler is a physician specialising in gynaecology and obstetrics who lists BICOM sessions among her complementary offers, rated 4.7 from 46 reviews.

Further west, Naturheilpraxis Rauch in Augsburg is the practice of Heilpraktiker Peter Rauch, who offers bioresonance, NLS sessions, a vital-field analysis with Vieva Pro, heart rate variability sessions and electroacupuncture after Dr. Voll. It is rated 4.9 from 54 reviews. Close by, the practice of Gerald Storm in Gersthofen is a general practice run by a physician that lists bioresonance after Paul Schmidt among its private offers, rated 4.4 from 36 reviews. In Obermeitingen, Naturheilpraxis Carolin Greiner-Mai combines osteopathy, hypnosis, coaching, biofeedback and neurofeedback with bioresonance, rated 5.0 from 29 reviews. In Penzberg, Heilpraktikerpraxis BalanceGanzheitlich Gabriele Zidek offers BICOM bioresonance, nutrition plans, lymph drainage and BodyTalk including distance sessions, rated 5.0 from 21 reviews.

The devices used across Bavaria vary. BICOM is common: it appears at Dr. med. Isa Kübler, at Stefan A. Mau's practice, at Naturheilpraxis Petra Schneider in Pastetten in the Erding district, at MU Dr. Katerina Hahn in Neutraubling, where the BICOM Body Check 2 is also offered, and at feelgood - Gesundheitspraxis Bayreuth, rated 5.0 from 23 reviews. Michael Binder's practice in Ansbach uses the Rayocomp PS 1000 polar bioresonance device from Rayonex, rated 5.0 from 27 reviews. NLS devices such as the Metatron Hunter are used at AIS Naturheilpraxis in München, rated 5.0 from 21 reviews. TimeWaver and remote sessions are the way several practitioners reach clients outside their own town.

Many practices here blend bioresonance with coaching, nutrition and relaxation work. Natürlich gesund und glücklich - Silvia Tischler in Schwarzhofen offers counselling, stress management, personality development and heart rate variability measurement, rated 5.0 from 36 reviews. Maria Rammel in Wallersdorf is a Heilpraktikerin, hormone coach and astrologer who also runs online courses and workshops, rated 5.0 from 31 reviews. faqs.q: Who offers BICOM bioresonance sessions in Bavaria?

faqs.q: Can I book a bioresonance session at a distance in Bavaria?

faqs.q: Who in Bavaria offers bioresonance sessions for animals?

intro: Berlin's page carries 20 bioresonance practitioners, and the city's districts shape where they work: Kreuzberg, Pankow, Moabit, Niederschönhausen, Lichterfelde in Steglitz-Zehlendorf, Zehlendorf, Westend, Charlottenburg, Wannsee, Spandau and Potsdamer Platz. Most are Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practices run by one person. Readers on the edge of the city can also open the pages for Brandenburg, Saxony-Anhalt, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Saxony and Thuringia.

BICOM is the device most often named. Naturheilpraxis Besler sits at Mariannenstraße 9-10 in Kreuzberg, has been in operation for more than 11 years, and offers BICOM bioresonance and frequency sessions; appointments can be booked through Doctolib, WhatsApp or phone, and it is rated 4.9 from 59 reviews, the largest review history on the page. Angela M. Bernstein runs a naturopathic practice built around BICOM bioresonance, with ear acupuncture and hypnosis, rated 4.6 from 43 reviews. Melanie Timm combines bioresonance sessions after Paul Schmidt with craniosacral work, Traditional Chinese Medicine and shiatsu, and adapts her approach for children; she is rated 5.0 from 4 reviews.

Jacqueline Bannert runs a women-owned practice in Lichterfelde with acupuncture, ear and skull acupuncture, Dorn work and bioresonance, with beauty acupuncture as her particular specialty, rated 4.3 from 4 reviews. Naturheilpraxis Jörg Geiger offers bioresonance with massage, acupuncture and nutrition and training programmes and is rated 3.4 from 5 reviews.

More practices round out the range. Heilpraxis Christiane Brischke offers acupuncture, homeopathy, foot reflexology, Reiki, bioresonance and Quantec, a contact-free approach she describes as suitable for people, animals and plants, rated 5.0 from 2 reviews. Naturheilpraxis am Roseneck in Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf is led by Dirk Seiffert, a second-generation Heilpraktiker, and is rated 5.0 from 14 reviews. Daniela Kniese, a Heilpraktiker in Wannsee, runs a family practice for children and adults, offers a free in-depth first interview and is rated 5.0 from 13 reviews. TriYoga-Berlin is a yoga studio that also offers bioresonance coaching, rated 5.0 from 2 reviews. Across the page there are 300 Google reviews with an average rating of 4.8.

faqs.q: Where in Berlin can I find a BICOM session?
faqs.a: Naturheilpraxis Besler in Kreuzberg, Angela M. Bernstein's naturopathic practice and Katharina Gnidtke in Niederschönhausen all work with BICOM. Gnidtke also offers a body scan with a Bicom device. Besler takes bookings through Doctolib, WhatsApp or phone.

faqs.q: Which Berlin practices work with Rayonex equipment?
faqs.a: Naturheilpraxis Conte, Manuela Grau in Moabit and Melanie Timm all offer bioresonance after Paul Schmidt (Rayonex). Timm also does craniosacral work and adapts her approach for children, and Conte starts every plan with a detailed first conversation.

faqs.q: Is there a Berlin practice that uses TimeWaver?
faqs.a: Katrin von Rabenau, a certified Heilpraktiker in Pankow, works with the TimeWaver information field technology and microcurrent sessions. She also holds online consultations and works with animals.

faqs.q: Who offers a free first call before booking in Berlin?
faqs.a: Carolin Leidecker offers a free 15-minute information call by phone, and appointments can then be booked through Doctolib or arranged by phone, email or WhatsApp. Melanie Timm also arranges a first conversation before starting. Daniela Kniese in Wannsee also offers a free first interview.

faqs.q: Which Berlin practices have more than one location?
faqs.a: Naturheilpraxis Reinhardt has rooms at Potsdamer Platz in Berlin and in Rangsdorf. Naturheilpraxis AMG works at Dieffenbachstraße 36 in Kreuzberg and at a second practice near Krumme Lanke in Berlin-Zehlendorf, where bioresonance is also offered.

faqs.q: Can I have a bioresonance consultation online in Berlin?
faqs.a: Katrin von Rabenau holds online consultations, and Akupunktur- und Naturheilpraxis Bannert in Lichterfelde also offers remote sessions. Confirm the format with the practice when you book.

A Bioflor cabinet offers bioresonance scan sessions that run around 30 minutes, with the NLS method named as the system in use, and adds personalised guidance on lifestyle and diet. It is rated 5.0 from 1 review. BIOREZONANTA ORADEA is rated 5.0 from 1 review; call ahead to confirm which sessions and device it offers.

The four practices on this page offer different entry points: a naturopathy centre with many device-based sessions, a recovery clinic, and two bioresonance cabinets. The rating spread is wide. Medica Sport Lumiro at 2.9 from 13 reviews and Natural Clinica at 5.0 from 8 reviews are both on the page, so read each rating together with its review count.

faqs.q: Who offers SCIO sessions in Oradea?
faqs.a: Natural Clinica offers bioresonance and SCIO packages along with biofeedback and neurofeedback. It is rated 5.0 from 8 reviews.

faqs.q: Where in Oradea is NLS used?
faqs.a: A Bioflor cabinet names the NLS method for sessions that run around 30 minutes, with lifestyle and diet guidance added. It is rated 5.0 from 1 review.

faqs.q: Which Oradea practice combines bioresonance with physiotherapy?
faqs.a: Medica Sport Lumiro, a recovery clinic, offers physiotherapy, traditional Chinese medicine and GUNA, plus wellness evaluations with a bioresonance device. It is rated 2.9 from 13 reviews.

faqs.q: Which nearby areas have their own page?

intro: Brandenburg's page wraps around Berlin, and that shapes who is on it. Of the 18 bioresonance practitioners listed here, a good share are in Potsdam and the towns around it, a handful are in Cottbus, and the rest are spread across smaller places such as Beeskow, Trebbin, Lychen, Pritzwalk, Michendorf and Hohen Neuendorf. Readers in the capital can open the Berlin page, and the pages for Saxony-Anhalt, Saxony, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Thuringia sit next door.

Potsdam and its neighbours carry the densest group. Heilpraktiker Martin Wohnlich runs a Naturheilpraxis in Potsdam that combines osteopathy, bioresonance and Ayurveda, and is rated 5.0 from 3 reviews. TCM-Babelsberg, led by Luisa Jarausch, mixes Chinese methods, functional approaches and bioresonance and is rated 5.0 from 18 reviews. Christiane E. Bergmann, Naturheilpraxis offers sessions with a Bio Scan and the Metatron HUNTER, rated 5.0 from 1 review. Heilpraktiker Stefan Andreas Beer runs Praxis Santulana in Werder, near Potsdam, with Ayurvedic massage and bioresonance sessions by phone appointment, rated 5.0 from 18 reviews.

Further out, Private PHYSIOTHERAPIE und HEILPRAXIS in Beeskow offers sessions on a Regumed BICOM Optima next to classic massage and manual work, rated 5.0 from 12 reviews, and Curatio in Cottbus offers BICOM sessions alongside osteopathy and physiotherapy, rated 4.7 from 10 reviews.

Naturheilpraxis Nina Wieczorek in Diedersdorf, near Seelow, is rated 4.7 from 15 reviews. The Naturheilpraxis in Michendorf combines bioresonance with yoga. Alternative Heilpraxis für Mensch und Tier in Schwielowsee has bioresonance as its main focus, offers sessions for people and animals, and serves Potsdam; it is rated 5.0 from 10 reviews.

Further north and east the practices are smaller. Naturheilpraxis Kirse in Lychen, in the Uckermark, is run by a Heilpraktiker who combines systemic osteopathy, kinesiology, energy massage and bioresonance, with BICOM sessions. Simone Gericke in Hohen Neuendorf (Bergfelde) runs a practice for homeopathy and bioresonance, with BICOM sessions from REGUMED. Praxis für Regulationsmedizin in Petershagen-Eggersdorf works with the TimeWaver med system. In Potsdam, a Heilpraktikerin's practice whose main areas are bioresonance and homeopathy is offered in Potsdam and Berlin and is rated 5.0 from 6 reviews.

Physician-led practices appear on this page for their bioresonance sessions. Sara Flassig is the family practice of a physician in Pritzwalk, rated 4.3 from 19 reviews. Across the page there are 205 Google reviews with an average rating of 4.8.

faqs.q: Who offers bioresonance sessions in Potsdam?
faqs.a: Several practices work in Potsdam. Heilpraktiker Martin Wohnlich combines osteopathy, bioresonance and Ayurveda. TCM-Babelsberg, led by Luisa Jarausch, offers Chinese methods with bioresonance. Naturheilpraxis Potsdam works with Bicom bioresonance from Regumed, and Christiane E. Bergmann, Naturheilpraxis uses a Bio Scan and the Metatron HUNTER.

faqs.q: Which Brandenburg practices use a BICOM device?
faqs.a: Private PHYSIOTHERAPIE und HEILPRAXIS in Beeskow uses a Regumed BICOM Optima, and Curatio in Cottbus offers BICOM sessions with Regumed equipment. Naturheilpraxis Potsdam and Praxis für Homöopathie und Bioresonanztherapie - Heilpraktikerin Simone Gericke are also listed for BICOM.

faqs.q: Are there sessions for animals as well as people in Brandenburg?
faqs.a: Yes. Alternative Heilpraxis für Mensch und Tier in Schwielowsee, run by Ulf Henschel, has an animal practice for small and large animals and a separate bioresonance practice for people, and the area it serves includes Potsdam. Appointments should be confirmed by phone.

faqs.q: Which Brandenburg practice is offered in Berlin as well?
faqs.a: A Heilpraktikerin's practice in Potsdam, whose main areas are bioresonance and homeopathy, is offered in Potsdam and Berlin and is rated 5.0 from 6 reviews. Ear acupuncture, complex homeopathy and craniosacral work are also on its menu. Berlin has its own page for readers searching there.

faqs.q: Who offers bioresonance sessions in Cottbus?
faqs.a: Heilpraktiker Cottbus - Tino Reinwart serves Cottbus and Brandenburg and combines Chinese-method approaches, nutrition counselling and bioresonance. Curatio in Cottbus brings together osteopathy, physiotherapy and bioresonance sessions with BICOM equipment from Regumed, led by Ines Hendel and Andreas Vogt.

intro: Brașov's page carries 7 bioresonance practitioners, all in the city itself. Several of them present bioresonance as one session type among body, mind and lifestyle offers rather than the whole business. Readers who can travel further can look at the pages for Prahova, Argeș, Sibiu, Mureș and Bucharest.

The review history here is led by ALTERMEDICA, rated 5.0 from 22 reviews. It describes an integrative approach to body recovery with a team of trained specialists, and its range includes postural gymnastics, kinesiology taping, craniosacral work, bioresonance, magnetotherapy, massage, manual lymphatic drainage and psychological counselling, individual or in a group. Holisterapia is a one-therapist practice working on body, mind and spirit, rated 5.0 from 1 review, and offers wellness scans with ZYTO, ITOVI and MindMI devices alongside psychological services and personal development courses.

Two cabinets work with the SCIO family of devices. One cabinet runs bioresonance and biofeedback sessions with a QXCI or SCIO device, described as a unit that sends and receives bio-fields using low-frequency currents, and suggests natural food supplements as part of its sessions. Centrul Angel is built around bioresonance with the Eductor system, which it presents as quantum biofeedback technology. Its first session, a full initial session, is free. Sessions can also be done at a distance from home, and there is a separate Eductor offer for animals.

A centre named Tara starts each visit with an assessment rather than anything else. In the bioresonance session, therapist and client sit together in front of a screen while the device reads weak electrical signals from the skin. Ayurvedic, traditional Chinese and psychosomatic counselling styles sit alongside it. ZenO Center takes an integrative approach to a conscious and balanced lifestyle, with bioresonance, holistic counselling, personal development, vocational counselling, nutrition counselling, mindfulness, and Reiki with radiesthesia. An appointment is recommended there, so call ahead to confirm what a session involves.

MOKI is a natural products shop that pairs herbal products and advice with bioresonance sessions. Its own description mentions personalised plans and specialised staff, and visits run by appointment as well as in-store shopping.

Across the page there are 23 Google reviews with an average rating of 5.0. ALTERMEDICA holds 22 of them, so the other six practices have at most one review between them, and that is the figure to weigh them by.

faqs.q: Who offers Eductor or SCIO sessions in Brașov?
faqs.a: Centrul Angel is built around bioresonance with the Eductor system, offers a free first session, distance sessions and a separate Eductor offer for animals. Another Brașov cabinet runs bioresonance and biofeedback sessions with a QXCI or SCIO device.

faqs.q: Where can I find ZYTO scans in Brașov?
faqs.a: Holisterapia is a one-therapist practice that offers wellness scans with ZYTO, ITOVI and MindMI devices, alongside psychological services and personal development courses. It is rated 5.0 from 1 review.

faqs.q: Which practice combines bioresonance with movement or manual work?
faqs.a: ALTERMEDICA lists postural gymnastics, joint mobilisation, kinesiology taping, craniosacral work, magnetotherapy, massage and lymphatic drainage next to bioresonance, with a team of trained specialists. It is rated 5.0 from 22 reviews.

faqs.q: Can I buy herbal products and book a session in one visit?
faqs.a: MOKI is a natural products shop in Brașov that pairs herbal products and advice with bioresonance sessions. Visits run by appointment as well as in-store, and a short visit is possible.

faqs.q: Is there a practice with sessions for animals or at a distance?
faqs.a: Centrul Angel offers sessions at a distance from home and a separate Eductor offer for animals. Its first session is free.

intro: The Bremen page covers 3 bioresonance practitioners, all led by or working with a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). A Heilpraktiker is not a doctor. It is rated 5.0 from 6 reviews.

Naturheilpraxis Katja Allert is a Heilpraktiker practice using bioresonance and vital field measurement, with dark-field microscopy and traditional Chinese medicine also offered. Opening hours are posted and appointments are recommended.

All three practices are in Bremen itself. Yoga & more is the one built around yoga and group work, with remote guidance when you cannot come in. Heiko Pust Hypnose has the longest record, since 1997. Naturheilpraxis Katja Allert is the third, and adds dark-field microscopy and a vital substance measurement carried out lying down with two electrodes over about 8 minutes, alongside bioresonance and vital field measurement.

Across the page there are 30 Google reviews with an average rating of 5.0. Bioresonance sessions are not covered by German statutory health insurance. Readers who can travel can also look at the pages for Lower Saxony, Hamburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Saxony-Anhalt and North Rhine-Westphalia.

faqs.q: Who offers remote bioresonance sessions in Bremen?
faqs.a: Yoga & more, run by Inga Becker, can run guided programmes by phone or online, and home visits are possible. It is rated 5.0 from 24 reviews.

faqs.q: Is there a hypnosis practice with bioresonance in Bremen?
faqs.a: Heiko Pust Hypnose combines bioresonance sessions with hypnosis, psychotherapy and coaching. He has practised in Bremen since 1997 and is rated 5.0 from 6 reviews.

faqs.q: What is a Heilpraktiker?
faqs.a: In Germany a Heilpraktiker is a state-licensed profession. A Heilpraktiker is not a doctor. All three Bremen practices are run by or with one.

faqs.q: Which nearby areas have their own page?
faqs.a: Lower Saxony, Hamburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Saxony-Anhalt and North Rhine-Westphalia each have a page. Readers outside the city of Bremen may find a closer practice on one of those pages.

intro: British Columbia spreads its bioresonance practitioners across Surrey, Burnaby, Langley, Vernon, Penticton, Creston, Winlaw, Sorrento, Harrison Hot Springs, Victoria, Qualicum Beach and Port Alberni. 13 practitioners are listed for the province, and the bioresonance practitioners here often describe themselves in terms of a wider wellness background, from nutrition to massage to skin care.

Nutrition is a clear thread in the Lower Mainland. Eating to Live Well Inc. is the Surrey practice of Valerie Mrakuzic, a Registered Holistic Nutritionist and Quantum Biofeedback Specialist, who offers a biofeedback scan with a nutritional report along with wellness and nutrition programs and a free first consultation. Integrative Medical Wellness IMW, also in Surrey, is a women-owned wellness clinic and natural health store with massage, wellness coaching, energy work and Qest4 bioenergetic sessions. In Burnaby, Dr. Peter Liu, ND is a licensed naturopathic doctor who speaks English and Mandarin and includes a biofeedback scan among nutrition, homeopathy and herbal services.

Outside Surrey and Burnaby, the setting changes. Enhance Studio Medi & Wellness Spa Ltd has served Vernon since 1986 and combines quantum and neuro biofeedback with colour, sound and skin care studio services. Biofeedback Treatment in Okanagan is a Penticton practice led by Charlene Reeves, who teaches holistic food principles and works with ZYTO, Indigo and SCIO systems. Magic Fingers Clinic, founded in 1997 by Christine Labrot, has moved to Creston and offers therapeutic massage, postural work with the Egoscue Method, a Life Expert 3.0 body scan and Energy Enhancement System sessions. Qwest 4 Health in Harrison Hot Springs is run by Dr. Diane Blackburn (DNM) and John, with an initial consultation that combines iridology and quantum biofeedback.

Devices are named across the page. Rayonex is the system at Allergy Elimination Centre Shuswap in Sorrento, where sensors are placed on the wrists and ankles. NES BioEnergetiX, with the miHealth device, is the core of Quantum Energy Healing, the Victoria practice of Wolfgang Zilker, who also offers an online bioenergy scan for clients at a distance. Omnipotent Health in Qualicum Beach, the practice of Lou Walkden, offers Solex AO Scan sessions in person or by Zoom. Sun Synergy Studio in Langley offers bioresonance sessions and Holographic Kinetics, and runs an online shop for bioresonance devices.

Remote and animal sessions exist but are not the norm. Magic Fingers Clinic, Quantum Energy Healing and Omnipotent Health all work at a distance. Biofeedback Treatment in Okanagan and Omnipotent Health also offer sessions for animals. Quantum Energy Healing and Eating to Live Well Inc. offer a free first consultation. Roselman Bioresonance in Port Alberni is a wellness center with bioresonance in its name.

For review history, Eating to Live Well Inc. has 4.7 from 39 reviews and Enhance Studio Medi & Wellness Spa Ltd has 4.6 from 31. Integrative Medical Wellness IMW has 5.0 from 24, and Magic Fingers Clinic has 4.9 from 23. Sun Synergy Studio has 5.0 from 7, and several others are rated 5.0 from 4 reviews or fewer.
Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario and Quebec have their own pages on this directory.

faqs.q: Which British Columbia practitioners use SCIO or ZYTO?
faqs.a: Enhance Studio Medi & Wellness Spa Ltd in Vernon works with SCIO. Biofeedback Treatment in Okanagan in Penticton names ZYTO, Indigo and SCIO among the many biofeedback systems it uses, led by Charlene Reeves.

faqs.q: Who offers remote bioenergy scans from British Columbia?
faqs.a: Quantum Energy Healing in Victoria, the practice of Wolfgang Zilker, offers an online bioenergy scan with subconscious coaching for clients at a distance. Magic Fingers Clinic in Creston and Omnipotent Health in Qualicum Beach also work remotely, the latter by Zoom.

faqs.q: Is there a licensed naturopathic doctor who offers a scan on this page?
faqs.a: Dr. Peter Liu, ND is a licensed naturopathic doctor in Burnaby who speaks English and Mandarin. His services include a biofeedback scan alongside nutrition, homeopathy and herbal medicine, and he offers Theralase cool laser sessions.

faqs.q: Which Victoria-area and island towns have a practice?
faqs.a: Quantum Energy Healing is in Victoria, Omnipotent Health in Qualicum Beach and Roselman Bioresonance in Port Alberni. Omnipotent Health also offers sessions for animals and works remotely.

faqs.q: Who offers a skin care studio alongside biofeedback?
faqs.a: Enhance Studio Medi & Wellness Spa Ltd in Vernon pairs quantum and neuro biofeedback, colour and sound sessions with skin services such as microdermabrasion and carbon laser facials, and has served Vernon since 1986.

intro: Bucharest's page carries 20 bioresonance practitioners, and the capital's sessions lean less toward Heilpraktiker-style naturopathy and more toward massage studios, aromatherapy, psychology offices and device-led centres. Aromatic Zen is a massage spa rated 5.0 from 15 reviews that offers aromatherapy massage with doTERRA oils and ZYTO scans. faqs.q: Where can I find BICOM bioresonance in London?

faqs.q: Which London practices offer Asyra sessions?
faqs.a: Japanese Acupuncture - Bioresonance & Supportive Therapies uses Asyra Pro, Lloyd Gee includes Asyra bioenergetic sessions with naturopathy, and biohealth in Newington Green, N1, works with Asyra Pro.

faqs.q: Is there a London practice that offers an NLS or Metatron scan?

intro: Louisiana's bioresonance practitioners are tied to massage, facials and nutrition as much as to scanning. Six practices share the page: Denham Springs, Folsom, Covington, Mandeville, New Orleans and Lafayette. ZYTO is named by four of them and the AO Scan by two. The 49 reviews on the page average 4.8.

Christine Palmer, a family nurse practitioner (FNP), has served Denham Springs for over a decade through Restore Health & Wellness. The practice offers vitamin infusion therapy, Apollo cold laser therapy, supplements and ZYTO scanning, and it is rated 5.0 from 39 reviews, every one of them five stars. It holds most of the review history on this page.

Three more practices sit in Folsom, Covington and Mandeville. Essential Wellness Energy Studio, LLC in Folsom offers holistic facials, Raindrop Technique, ZYTO scans, salt therapy and BioMat sessions, and serves St. Tammany. It is rated 5.0 from 6 reviews. Unwind with Esther LLC. in Covington pairs massage therapy with a custom set of frequencies designed by the AO Scan, aimed at relaxation and nervous system balance, and Esther also teaches Hanna Somatic movement. It is rated 5.0 from 3 reviews. Ivy Vitality Wellness Center in Mandeville offers ZYTO scan sessions, wellness coaching, PEMF, infrared sauna, the Raindrop technique, Emotion Code and EVOX perception reframing, with juice programs, personal training and Pilates as well. It is new to the page.

Step N2 Health in Lafayette draws on 30 years in natural health, and a ZYTO biofeedback session starts each client's nutritional support plan, backed by reflexology and aromatherapy with essential oil blends made up as roll-ons, sprays and lotions. Appointments are required, and it is rated 4.0 from 1 review.

Health and Healing with Daile in New Orleans is a massage practice that blends bodywork with Bio-Resonance AO scans, essential oils, hot stones, infrared light and tuning forks. Services include Ahiatsu barefoot massage and the Young Living Raindrop Technique, with coaching, meditation and breathwork. Daile is also a Master Spiritual Life, Health and Mindset Coach, and the practice is new to the page.

The settings differ more than the devices do: a nurse practitioner's office, a studio for facials and salt sessions, a massage practice and a natural health practice built on reflexology. Neighbouring pages cover Alabama, Texas, Georgia, Tennessee and Oklahoma, which is helpful for anyone living close to a state line.

faqs.q: Who offers ZYTO scans in Louisiana?

faqs.q: Where in Louisiana can I find an AO Scan session?
faqs.a: Unwind with Esther LLC. in Covington pairs massage with a custom set of frequencies designed by the AO Scan, and Health and Healing with Daile in New Orleans blends massage with Bio-Resonance AO scans. Unwind with Esther is rated 5.0 from 3 reviews.

faqs.a: Essential Wellness Energy Studio, LLC in Folsom serves St. Tammany, Unwind with Esther LLC. is in Covington and Ivy Vitality Wellness Center is in Mandeville. All three offer scan sessions alongside facials, massage, PEMF or infrared sauna.

faqs.q: Is there a practitioner with a nursing background in Louisiana?
faqs.a: Christine Palmer FNP Restore Health & Wellness in Denham Springs is led by a family nurse practitioner who has served the town for over a decade. It offers ZYTO scanning with supplements and cold laser, and is rated 5.0 from 39 reviews.

faqs.q: Which pages sit next to Louisiana?
faqs.a: Alabama, Texas, Georgia, Tennessee and Oklahoma each have their own page. They are worth a look for anyone near a state line who is willing to travel.

intro: Lower Saxony has 47 bioresonance practitioners, and they are spread over towns from Braunschweig and Göttingen to Osnabrück, Delmenhorst and Ostrhauderfehn. For someone searching for bioresonance practitioners in Lower Saxony, the choice is mostly between practices in mid-sized towns and in smaller places such as Burgwedel, Laatzen, Melbeck near Lüneburg and Bleckede in the Elbtalaue. Some practices here also work in Saxony. The neighbouring region pages are Bremen, Hamburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Saxony-Anhalt and North Rhine-Westphalia.

Bioresonance sessions sit next to acupuncture, homeopathy, cupping, laser and magnetic field applications and nutrition counselling. It is rated 5.0 from 197 reviews. Appointments are by arrangement only, by email. In Wendeburg, Anja Zuzak Specialist f. General medicine is a private practice focused on regulative medicine that includes bioresonance, rated 4.4 from 25 reviews.

Heilpraktiker practices make up much of the rest. In Einbeck, Praxis für Osteopathie und Naturheilverfahren - Markus Schürmann adds BICOM bioresonance to osteopathy and acupuncture for adults and children, with a free introductory consultation that can be booked online, and it is rated 5.0 from 66 reviews. Naturheilpraxis Sannapiu in Burgwedel has served families for more than 20 years, led by a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who is also a trained children's nurse, rated 5.0 from 31 reviews. Lebenswandel - Heilpraktiker Praxisgemeinschaft in Laatzen offers osteopathy, bioresonance and kinesiology and works with infants and children, rated 5.0 from 21 reviews.

Lüneburg and its surroundings have their own cluster. The Zentrum für Bioresonanz & Naturheilkunde in Melbeck near Lüneburg, led by Heilpraktiker Olivia Gonzales, has worked with bioenergetic concepts since 2003 and uses bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, rated 5.0 from 25 reviews. Silke Gehrke Heilpraktikerin in the Elbtalaue area near Bleckede works as a certified bioresonance therapist alongside craniosacral, Dorn and Breuss approaches, rated 5.0 from 18 reviews. (hr) Stella Schulte, a Tierheilpraktikerin in Osnabrück, works with homeopathy, Penzel acupressure for horses and dogs, Bach flowers and bioresonance for animals, rated 5.0 from 35 reviews. Miriam Kaufmann - Ganzheitliches Coaching in Delmenhorst combines coaching with kinesiology, Human Design and the TimeWaver system, with sessions on site, by phone or online and a free first call of 20 to 30 minutes, rated 5.0 from 21 reviews.

In Göttingen, Praxis Dr. Ströhlein is a practice for Chinese medicine and Western naturopathic methods, rated 4.8 from 16 reviews. Several smaller practices round out the region with BICOM, Rayonex or NLS sessions. Among them is Praxis für Naturheilverfahren Elke Albers, which lists BICOM and NLS sessions and also sessions for animals. Naturheilpraxis Kathrin Sommer-Rah and Kirsten Schulz-Oberjohann Bioresonanz both work with Rayonex devices, and each is rated 5.0.

faqs.q: Who offers BICOM bioresonance in Lower Saxony?

faqs.q: Which practices near Lüneburg offer bioresonance?

Silke Gehrke Heilpraktikerin works in the Elbtalaue area near Bleckede as a certified bioresonance therapist. Appointment requests for Melbeck go through a form.

faqs.a: Miriam Kaufmann - Ganzheitliches Coaching in Delmenhorst offers a free first call of 20 to 30 minutes and sessions on site, by phone or online. Praxis für Osteopathie und Naturheilverfahren - Markus Schürmann in Einbeck offers a free introductory consultation that can be booked online.

faqs.q: Which region pages are next to Lower Saxony?

intro: Winnipeg and Winkler hold most of Manitoba's bioresonance practitioners, and a few more sit in Ste Anne, Steinbach and Lorette. 10 practitioners are listed for the province. What marks Manitoba among bioresonance practitioners is how closely the work is tied to Rayonex training in Germany, which two Winnipeg practices describe in some detail.

ANANIA Wellness Clinic at 865 Henderson Highway in Winnipeg combines bioresonance, holistic nutrition, Chinese medicine and infrared light therapy. Its owner, Michelle, is a certified bioresonance practitioner who began her training in 2014 and gained certification at Rayonex Biomedical in Lennestadt, Germany in 2016, and she is now a lead distributor for Rayonex. A Rayoscan session is among the services. Bioresonance Therapy Winnipeg is the practice of Alexia Papagiannopoulos, who began practising in March 2015 and completed Paul Schmidt's bioresonance training and certification course at Rayonex Biomedical in September 2016. She describes sessions as non-invasive and gentle and offers a free 30 minute consultation.

Other Winnipeg entries are shorter on detail, and they suit a reader who wants to phone and ask. Bioresonance Infinity Winnipeg is at 24 Mestre Pl and focuses on frequency sessions under the tagline Recover and Restore with Frequencies, with pages that explain bioresonance and a quitting smoking page. Healing Freq in Winnipeg is a bioresonance practice, also described as biofeedback, with non-invasive sessions that aim to support a healthy lifestyle. Anyone in the city can contact either to ask which device is used and how appointments are booked. Between the four Winnipeg practices, a reader can choose between a clinic that also works with nutrition and Chinese medicine, two Rayonex-trained practitioners, and two frequency-focused rooms, all within one city.

Outside Winnipeg, the practices are small and varied. Renew Wellness Center in Winkler offers massage from a Registered Massage Therapist or a student, athletic therapy, acupuncture, counselling and craniosacral therapy, with bioresonance and red light therapy offered by a Registered Holistic Nutrition Practitioner who also gives nutritional and lifestyle guidance. Soul Iris, also in Winkler, offers health consultations, reflexology and bio resonance sessions, and carries supplements, protein powders and organic loose teas. Carole's Bioresonance Therapy in Ste Anne offers bioresonance sessions, a frequency-based technology. Health on Purpose, also in Ste Anne near Blumenort, offers biofeedback and bioresonance and is expecting partners and affiliates in other parts of Canada.

Steinbach has Green Table Talk, which takes a total wellness approach built around quantum biofeedback sessions, stress management coaching and type-based nutrition. Its Google rating is 3.0 from 2 reviews, one at five stars and one at one star. GRM Bioresonance is a wellness centre in Lorette that can be contacted directly. Health on Purpose, mentioned above, also offers a brochure to download and shares client experiences on its pages, and the Steinbach and Lorette entries show that the method is not confined to the Winnipeg area, since each has its own local practice for a reader to contact.

Review history here includes one very large count. Renew Wellness Center in Winkler has 5.0 from 239 reviews, ANANIA Wellness Clinic has 5.0 from 49, and Bioresonance Therapy Winnipeg has 5.0 from 13. Soul Iris has 5.0 from 6, and Bioresonance Infinity Winnipeg and Carole's Bioresonance Therapy each have 5.0 from 4.
Saskatchewan, Alberta, Ontario, British Columbia and Quebec have their own pages on this directory.

faqs.a: ANANIA Wellness Clinic, whose owner is certified through Rayonex Biomedical in Lennestadt and offers Rayoscan sessions, and Bioresonance Therapy Winnipeg, where Alexia Papagiannopoulos completed Paul Schmidt's course, both name Rayonex.

faqs.q: Is there a free first consultation in Manitoba?

faqs.a: Renew Wellness Center and Soul Iris are both in Winkler. Renew Wellness Center offers bioresonance and red light therapy from a Registered Holistic Nutrition Practitioner, and Soul Iris offers health consultations, reflexology and bio resonance sessions.

faqs.q: Which towns outside Winnipeg have a practice?
faqs.a: Ste Anne has Carole's Bioresonance Therapy and Health on Purpose, Steinbach has Green Table Talk, Lorette has GRM Bioresonance and Winkler has Renew Wellness Center and Soul Iris.

faqs.q: How can I contact ANANIA Wellness Clinic?
faqs.a: ANANIA Wellness Clinic is at 865 Henderson Highway in Winnipeg. It combines bioresonance with holistic nutrition, Chinese medicine and infrared light therapy, and its owner Michelle is a lead distributor for Rayonex.

faqs.q: Who offers ZYTO scans in Massachusetts?

faqs.q: Can I have a bioresonance session remotely in Massachusetts?

intro: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern's page carries 9 bioresonance practitioners spread along the state's length: Greifswald in the north-east, Rostock on the coast, and Neubrandenburg, Waren, Groß Laasch and Kemnitz further inland. Almost nothing here is a big-city clinic. Most of these are small practices run by one person, so a visitor is usually choosing a practitioner and then planning a drive. Readers near the state border can also look at the pages for Schleswig-Holstein, Hamburg, Brandenburg, Berlin and Saxony-Anhalt.

Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) is the title that comes up most. Naturheilpraxis Helianthus in Neubrandenburg is the practice of Adam Sykulski, who combines bioresonance with nutrition counselling, cupping, Bach flowers and several kinds of massage. Nicole Plüschau runs a naturopathic practice in Waren, is also a registered nurse, and offers bioresonance sessions and the Bicom Body Check.

Two practices lean on physicians. Osteopathiepraxis Zirzow in Greifswald is led by Axel Zirzow, a physician specialising in general medicine and chirotherapy, and offers osteopathy, acupuncture, hypnosis and bioresonance, rated 4.3 from 26 reviews. Dipl.-Med. Torsten Hasselberg, Allgemeinmediziner runs a general practice in Rostock, offers acupuncture, a BICOM optima device with the BICOM Body Check, and biofeedback sessions on a computer-supported system. It is rated 3.3 from 46 reviews, the largest review history on the page.

The device differs by practice. BICOM is available in Rostock and in Waren with Nicole Plüschau. Juliane Reincke, a Heilpraktikerin in Groß Laasch, works with a Metatron Hunter full-body scan, a TimeWaver session, heart rate variability measurement with the NILAS system and the Emotion Code. Her practice is rated 5.0 from 6 reviews. Hasselberg's practice also lists a SCIO, Indigo or Eductor style system.

Not every practice is a naturopathic one. Gemeinschaftspraxis für Potenzialentfaltung in Neubrandenburg is a shared practice for neuro-centred vision training, aura and energy work, auditory perception training, posturology and bioresonance, with programmes for pre-school children, school children and adults. Energy work there can be done as a distance session, and it is rated 5.0 from 7 reviews. Praxis Linde in Kemnitz is a physiotherapy practice, led by Jens Linde, a physiotherapist and Heilpraktiker, that adds massage, lymph drainage, acupuncture and bioresonance. It is rated 4.9 from 8 reviews.

Some practitioners cover more than one town. Cornelia Maak has worked as a Heilpraktikerin for more than 25 years, with practices in Waren (Lange Straße 22) and Hamburg, and offers eye acupuncture and bioresonance alongside; the practice pages give a Waren phone number for booking. She is rated 5.0 from 4 reviews. Across the page there are 102 Google reviews with an average rating of 4.7.

Smaller review histories are worth reading with their counts. Naturheilpraxis Helianthus is rated 5.0 from 2 reviews, and Nicole Plüschau's practice is rated 5.0 from 1 review. A Naturheilpraxis led by Dr. rer. nat. Roland Schulze offers a free first consultation and is rated 4.5 from 2 reviews.

faqs.q: Who offers BICOM bioresonance sessions in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern?
faqs.a: Dipl.-Med. Torsten Hasselberg, Allgemeinmediziner in Rostock uses a BICOM optima device with the BICOM Body Check. Naturheilpraxis NicolePlüschau in Waren offers bioresonance sessions with Bicom and the Bicom Body Check, and she is rated 5.0 from 1 review.

In Neubrandenburg, Naturheilpraxis Helianthus is the practice of Adam Sykulski, Heilpraktiker. A Heilpraktiker is a state-licensed alternative practitioner.

faqs.q: Who in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern works with TimeWaver or a Metatron?
faqs.a: Juliane Reincke, a Heilpraktikerin in Groß Laasch, offers a Metatron Hunter full-body scan and a TimeWaver session with TimeWaver Frequency. Her practice also uses heart rate variability measurement with the NILAS system and the Emotion Code. She is rated 5.0 from 6 reviews.

faqs.q: Can I book a distance session?

faqs.q: Which practices in Greifswald or Rostock offer bioresonance?

intro: In Quebec, bioresonance practitioners on this page include massage therapists, a naturopath and Pilates studios, working in English and French from Montreal, Val-David, Candiac and Boisbriand. Six practices are shown, and together they hold 117 reviews at an average of 5.0.

Montreal has two entries with large review counts. Amparo ૐ massage & soins énergétiques is the practice of a massage and somatic therapist, vocal artist and educator originally from Buenos Aires. Her training includes Swedish and Thai massage, Quantum Scio biofeedback and bio-resonance therapy, and Reiki, and appointments are required. It is rated 5.0 from 55 reviews. Douce-Nature is a naturopath's office run by Hanane Mrabet Temsamani, a graduate naturopath who uses a ZYTO bioscanner as part of her sessions, with stress management and personalized meal planning. It welcomes LGBTQ clients, has a wheelchair accessible entrance, and is rated 5.0 from 27 reviews.

Jodie Duplisea Massothérapie in Val-David offers Tui Na, Thai, Californian and Swedish massage, osteodynamics, Aqua-Vie hot water massage, yoga, meditation, coaching and bioresonance. Retreats, sound baths and wellness days are on the calendar. It is rated 5.0 from 29 reviews, 28 of them five stars.

Candiac has two studios in the same line of work. illu Space is a holistic wellness studio pairing Pilates and yoga with TimeWaver frequency work, Aromatouch and fascia release, rated 5.0 from 5 reviews. Aroma Power Plants Healing Center shares space with Lixin Pilates, offering aromatherapy, Reiki and TimeWaver frequency sessions, rated 5.0 from 1 review. TimeWaver is the one device that appears in more than one practice here, and it is named only in Candiac.

Heal With Josée - Body Mind Spirit Healing in Boisbriand is run by Josée Roussy, who offers energy and frequency sessions for people and animals, all delivered at a distance in English and French. She is a certified Emotion Code, Body Code and Belief Code practitioner, and her work includes bioresonance with the AO Scan, an introductory scan and demo scans. A free consultation is available, and the practice is new to the page.

Amparo's practice is the one that names SCIO, and the ZYTO scanner sits in Montreal at Douce-Nature. Most of these practices pair the sessions with something else, whether massage, Pilates, yoga or aromatherapy, so the first call is a good moment to ask what a first visit includes and in which language it runs. Neighbouring pages cover Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Alberta and British Columbia, for anyone looking beyond the province.

faqs.q: Which Quebec practitioners work in French and English?

faqs.a: illu Space and Aroma Power Plants Healing Center, both in Candiac, offer TimeWaver frequency sessions. illu Space pairs them with Pilates, yoga and Aromatouch and is rated 5.0 from 5 reviews. Aroma Power Plants shares space with Lixin Pilates and is rated 5.0 from 1 review.

faqs.a: Douce-Nature is a naturopath's office in Montreal that uses a ZYTO bioscanner, rated 5.0 from 27 reviews. Amparo ૐ massage & soins énergétiques, also in Montreal, lists Quantum Scio biofeedback and is rated 5.0 from 55 reviews.

faqs.q: Can sessions be done at a distance in Quebec?
faqs.a: Heal With Josée - Body Mind Spirit Healing in Boisbriand delivers all sessions at a distance, for people and animals, using bioresonance with the AO Scan. A free consultation is available.

faqs.q: Which pages sit next to Quebec?
faqs.a: Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Alberta and British Columbia each have their own page. They help anyone near a provincial border who is willing to travel.

intro: In Queensland, bioresonance is mostly a naturopath's tool, and the 30 bioresonance practitioners on this page are clustered along the coast from Brisbane up through the Gold Coast and the Sunshine Coast. Naturopaths and homeopaths use BICOM, NES and MORA systems alongside nutrition and herbal consultations. The page also reaches north to Innisfail and the Whitsundays, so the coastal strip is where most readers will find a practice close by.

The Gold Coast group is the most varied. Naturopath Australia in Mermaid Beach was established in 1993 and offers MORA therapy beside naturopath consultations, with a free first consultation and sessions for animals; it is rated 4.8 from 17 reviews. Vivaciti Health Services in Miami combines bioresonance biofeedback with intuitive energy work, with selected sessions available remotely, rated 5.0 from 18 reviews. One Sky Wellbeing in Palm Beach is a naturopathic practice for women, with consultations in person and by telehealth across Australia, rated 5.0 from 6 reviews. AKASHA Healing Haven in Mudgeeraba works with INDIGO, SCIO and QXCI quantum biofeedback and also offers kinesiology and Reiki, rated 5.0 from 6 reviews.

On the Sunshine Coast, Peace of Eden at Kiels Mountain is a naturopathic practice within reach of Nambour, Maleny and Montville, and it offers remote sessions; it is rated 5.0 from 22 reviews. Eliza Blackwood is a naturopath and nutritionist with more than 25 years of experience who offers NES Health scans in person or remotely, rated 5.0 from 6 reviews. Michelle Cose sees clients in Maroochydore through The Herb Emporium with an NES body scanner, and Ruby Tickner in Palmview serves clients from across the Sunshine Coast with a German bio resonance technology. Jenny Blondel in Peregian Springs pairs naturopathic tools with bioenergetic technology and takes online bookings. Mora Therapy in Noosa is an acupuncture clinic offering sessions on a MORA machine, rated 4.5 from 8 reviews.

Brisbane has a different feel, with practices set inside shared wellness spaces. Samadhi Hart Bioresonance in West End is set within The Green Grocer herbal dispensary and offers bioresonance frequency sessions and an AO Scan for adults and children, with remote options; it is rated 4.9 from 30 reviews. The Wellness Collective in Birkdale, brought together by Sera Liora Wilde, offers bioresonance beside massage, Reiki, kinesiology and yoga, rated 5.0 from 13 reviews. Jayne Bryson Naturopathy in Graceville has over two decades of experience, rated 5.0 from 9 reviews. BioBalance4Health in Brighton works with a Bicom machine within a naturopathy and homeopathy practice, rated 5.0 from 6 reviews. Milo Milosevic Naturopathy Bio Resonance in Toowong adds Bowen therapy, and Jane Lindsay, a registered homeopath working in Bardon and Brisbane, uses NES alongside homeopathy and offers a free first consultation.

Further afield, Trisha Scott in Bongaree is a kinesiologist with 35 years of experience who adds bioresonance to Bowen and myofascial work. Natural Healing Whitsundays in Cannonvale offers bioresonance sessions built around an energetic technology approach, and Bioresonance Therapy Innisfail in Innisfail lists bioresonance as its single service.

Remote sessions are common here, offered by Samadhi Hart Bioresonance, Peace of Eden, Vivaciti, Naturopath Australia, One Sky Wellbeing, Eliza Blackwood, Ruby Tickner and Jane Lindsay, so readers in regional towns are not limited to what is local. Readers near the state line can also look at the neighbouring pages for New South Wales, Victoria and South Australia.

faqs.q: Which Queensland practices offer remote bioresonance sessions?
faqs.a: Samadhi Hart Bioresonance in Brisbane, Peace of Eden on the Sunshine Coast, Vivaciti Health Services in Miami, One Sky Wellbeing in Palm Beach and Eliza Blackwood all describe remote or telehealth options.

faqs.q: Who offers NES Health scans in Queensland?
faqs.a: Eliza Blackwood on the Sunshine Coast uses the Energy 4 Life NES system, and Michelle Cose in Maroochydore uses an NES body scanner. Jane Lindsay, a registered homeopath in Bardon and Brisbane, also works with NES.

faqs.a: BioBalance4Health in Brighton, Queensland, uses a Bicom machine within a naturopathy practice led by Wendy. It is rated 5.0 from 6 reviews.

faqs.a: Kiels Mountain, Maroochydore, Peregian Springs, Graceville, Toowong, Brighton, Mermaid Beach and Palm Beach each have a naturopath who offers bioresonance as part of consultations.

faqs.a: Naturopath Australia in Mermaid Beach lists sessions for animals. Optimal Wellbeing and Healing Syndicate also list sessions for animals, so there are options on the Gold Coast and beyond.

intro: Rhineland-Palatinate's page carries 31 bioresonance practitioners, and they work in towns spread across the whole state: Bitburg, Trier, Mainz, Ludwigshafen, Worms, Montabaur, Boppard, Idar-Oberstein, Simmern, Nierstein and a string of smaller places in between. A visitor here is usually weighing a practice in the home town against one a short drive away. Readers near the state line can also look at the pages for Saarland, Hesse, North Rhine-Westphalia, Baden-Württemberg and Thuringia.

Many of the practices are run by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner), and most of them combine bioresonance sessions with other natural methods.
