Naturheilpraxis Fehmel in Boppard has been run by Gudrun Fehmel since 2012 and offers a whole-body scan based on the NLS system. In Idar-Oberstein, Michael Kiy works as Heilpraktiker and chiropractor and offers bioresonance sessions with the BICOM device.

A second group pairs bioresonance with osteopathy or physiotherapy. Osteopathie Gesa-Fee Velten in Montabaur is a team of 7 osteopaths, Heilpraktiker and physiotherapists, rated 4.8 from 45 reviews, the largest review history on this page. Sanadios Ganzheitliche Naturheilpraxis GbR in Mainz is a group practice rated 4.8 from 19 reviews, and Naturheilpraxis Alexandra Krohn in Ludwigshafen is rated 5.0 from 21 reviews and runs a children's practice with homeopathy for young clients. In Nierstein, Praxis Dr. med. Sybille Freund is the practice of a physician and is rated 4.8 from 21 reviews.

Bitburg and Trier give the western part of the state its own cluster. Janardhan in Bitburg is an alternative practice and yoga studio rated 4.9 from 16 reviews, with Reiki, Ayurveda and bioresonance sessions for people and for their animals. The Amitayus centre, led by Iris Sedlar, offers acupuncture, Tibetan methods, nutrition counselling and bioresonance and is rated 4.2 from 13 reviews. Naturheilpraxis Éva Csizmadia, rated 4.8 from 5 reviews, has trained with Regumed, the bioresonance device maker. In Trier, Tina Flohr is a psychologist (M.Sc.) and Heilpraktikerin rated 5.0 from 15 reviews, and a separate practice there is built around TimeWaver.

The device on offer differs by practice. BICOM sessions are available with Michael Kiy in Idar-Oberstein and with Naturheilpraxis Iskandarani in Bollendorf, which uses a BICOM Optima and is rated 4.8 from 5 reviews. Rayonex systems are used by Tanja Schmitz in Speicher, a health consultant and Reiki master rated 4.4 from 7 reviews. NLS sessions with a Metatron or an Oberon are offered by Waldemar Kunz in Simmern, a Heilpraktiker and chiropractor rated 5.0 from 7 reviews, and by Naturheilpraxis Fehmel.

Some practices work beyond their own town. Bioresonanz & Ernährungsberatung Kirf serves the Trier, Saarburg and Merzig area and nearby Luxembourg, combines bioresonance with nutrition counselling, and also holds online consultations; it is rated 5.0 from 3 reviews. Heilpraxis Enns in Plaidt offers a free first conversation of 15 minutes before booking and is rated 5.0 from 6 reviews. Across the page there are 252 Google reviews with an average rating of 4.8. Heilpraxis/ Praxis für ganzheitliche Methodik in Mainz is rated 3.0 from 2 reviews, and Divine Magic Whisper, a Reiki practice in Worms, is rated 5.0 from 2 reviews. Smaller practices include Naturheilpraxis Grünfelder in Riedelberg, run by a Heilpraktiker and rated 5.0 from 5 reviews, Heilpraktikerin Anita Gomille in Lemberg, rated 5.0 from 2 reviews, and Naturheilpraxis Lebensenergie Bettina Anstett, rated 5.0 from 1 review.

faqs.a: Bioresonanz & Ernährungsberatung Kirf holds appointments on site and also offers online consultations, and it serves the Trier, Saarburg and Merzig area and nearby Luxembourg. The Amitayus centre led by Iris Sedlar offers bioresonance alongside nutrition counselling and acupuncture. Naturheilpraxis Éva Csizmadia focuses on Chinese methods and bioresonance.

faqs.a: Heilpraxis Enns in Plaidt offers a free first conversation of 15 minutes so new clients can meet the practitioner. Osteopathie Gesa-Fee Velten in Montabaur offers a free advice call, and Holistic Coaching Team also lists a free first consultation.

Heiko Ruser in Merzig is a qualified sports teacher as well as a Heilpraktiker, and Linda Oehm in Merzig adds Reiki and kinesio and meridian taping to her session menu.
Where a device is named, it is BICOM at Denise Ory's practice and Rayonex at the two practices that follow Paul Schmidt. Across the page there are 92 Google reviews with an average rating of 4.8.

faqs.a: Gemeinschaftspraxis Morozova Morozov in Saarbrücken is a group practice led by Diana Morozova and Alexander Morozov, with general practice at its core. It also offers bioresonance, vital field technology sessions and Biomeditation, and is rated 4.1 from 45 reviews.

faqs.q: Who in Saarland works with the Dorn and Breuss method?
faqs.a: Eva-Maria Kaisner in Illingen lists Dorn and Breuss spinal therapy next to classical homeopathy, ear acupuncture and bioresonance. intro: Saskatchewan's three bioresonance practitioners work in Regina, Fort Qu'Appelle and Lloydminster, and two of them take remote clients. Between them they use SCIO and AO Scan, and one is a quantum biofeedback specialist with a wider coaching background.

Remote work is part of the picture in two of the three towns, with the Regina practitioner and the Fort Qu'Appelle center both offering sessions at a distance, while Lloydminster is an in-person centre with a shop attached.
Readers near the provincial borders can look at the pages for Alberta, Manitoba, British Columbia, Ontario and Quebec.

faqs.a: At All About Stress Release & More, the practitioner is a certified TRE provider, a certified quantum biofeedback specialist, and a certified NLP practitioner, with training in nutritional counselling.

intro: Saxony's page carries 21 bioresonance practitioners, and the three big cities are all on it: Dresden, Leipzig and Chemnitz, plus Freiberg, Zwickau, Görlitz and a ring of smaller towns such as Zwönitz, Taucha, Borna and Laußnitz. faqs.q: Who offers bioresonance sessions in Dresden?

faqs.a: Bożena Banczyk - Coach dich gesund works in Görlitz and Zgorzelec in German and Polish. She combines DNA-based nutrition, bioresonance analysis and micronutrient guidance, with sessions on site or online, and is rated 5.0 from 19 reviews.

On review history, Torus Tree has 5.0 from 50 reviews and Bioresonance of life has 5.0 from 44. Irene McCabe has 5.0 from 20, and Jan de Vries Blythswood has 4.9 from 9. BioResonate BioResonance Glasgow has 4.6 from 9, and several others are rated 5.0 from 2 reviews or fewer.
